scope: Four inherited descriptive cases; object acted upon from base+wrist trajectories, not an internal attention-patch label or a global rate.

isolated_endpoint_effects.C400_with_P200_D200: 0/4 redirections, all four manipulate correct BBQ; success3/4 with exchanged successful state0/state37
isolated_endpoint_effects.D400_with_P200_C200: 3/4 redirections to green distractor; only state25 continues correct BBQ and succeeds
isolated_endpoint_effects.state25_interaction: Each isolated new block retains BBQ selection; D400 combined with P400 or C400 redirects to green.
